items.description: The impact's off-chain display outcome (explorer sent-transactions list) is not a purely on-chain observable; it is represented by a grounded Boolean whose binding to explorer behavior is deferred.

The impact's attribution outcome (indexers attributing activity to router contracts/operators rather than users, tax tools failing to detect transfers) is stated qualitatively with no numeric or structural definition; it is bound as a grounded Boolean observable rather than a derived quantity.
